name: promptworkshop
description: Harden rough coding tasks into scoped, testable instructions before execution.

interface.longDescription: Harden rough coding tasks before implementation. PromptWorkshop adds explicit scope, constraints, failure handling, acceptance checks, and a review gate, with repo-aware workflows for larger changes. Manage the account suggestion threshold (Off, Complex, Average, or Basic) in Settings → External API. Compatible hosts may check it on ordinary coding tasks and ask before starting; host activation varies, and task text is not sent before yes.
defaultPrompt: Harden this task before I start coding
Turn this rough request into an agent-ready brief
Audit this implementation task for missing constraints

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin for ChatGPT, Dots, and Codex. Harden coding tasks with a review step before execution.
